```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(pdp)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

set.seed(679)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("Food_Delivery_Times.csv")

glimpse(df)
summary(df)
```

```{r}
missing_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(colSums(is.na(df))),
  Missing = as.numeric(colSums(is.na(df)))
) %>%
  filter(Missing > 0)

missing_table %>%
  kable(caption = "Missing value counts in raw dataset.") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

sum(!complete.cases(df))

sum(complete.cases(df))
```

```{r}
df_clean <- df %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    Weather = factor(Weather),
    Traffic_Level = factor(Traffic_Level),
    Time_of_Day = factor(Time_of_Day),
    Vehicle_Type = factor(Vehicle_Type)
  )

nrow(df_clean)

Q1 <- quantile(df_clean$Delivery_Time_min, 0.25)
Q3 <- quantile(df_clean$Delivery_Time_min, 0.75)
IQR_value <- IQR(df_clean$Delivery_Time_min)

lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value

extreme_values <- df_clean %>%
  filter(
    Delivery_Time_min < lower_bound |
      Delivery_Time_min > upper_bound
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Delivery_Time_min))

extreme_values
```

```{r}
set.seed(679)

train_index <- createDataPartition(
  df_clean$Delivery_Time_min,
  p = 0.8,
  list = FALSE
)

train_data <- df_clean[train_index, ]
test_data  <- df_clean[-train_index, ]

nrow(train_data)
nrow(test_data)
```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Delivery_Time_min)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 35, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Delivery Time",
    x = "Minutes",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Weather, y = Delivery_Time_min, fill = Weather)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "By Weather",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Delivery Time (min)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

p3 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Distance_km, y = Delivery_Time_min)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distance vs Time",
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Delivery Time (min)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

figure1 <- p1 + p2 + p3
figure1
```

```{r}
lm_fit <- lm(
  Delivery_Time_min ~ Distance_km +
    Preparation_Time_min +
    Courier_Experience_yrs +
    Weather +
    Traffic_Level +
    Time_of_Day +
    Vehicle_Type,
  data = train_data
)

summary(lm_fit)

lm_pred <- predict(lm_fit, newdata = test_data)

```

```{r}
set.seed(679)

rf_fit <- randomForest(
  Delivery_Time_min ~ Distance_km +
    Preparation_Time_min +
    Courier_Experience_yrs +
    Weather +
    Traffic_Level +
    Time_of_Day +
    Vehicle_Type,
  data = train_data,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = 3,
  importance = TRUE
)

rf_fit

rf_pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_data)
```

```{r}
xgb_formula <- Delivery_Time_min ~ Distance_km +
  Preparation_Time_min +
  Courier_Experience_yrs +
  Weather +
  Traffic_Level +
  Time_of_Day +
  Vehicle_Type

x_train <- model.matrix(xgb_formula, data = train_data)[, -1]
y_train <- train_data$Delivery_Time_min

x_test <- model.matrix(xgb_formula, data = test_data)[, -1]
y_test <- test_data$Delivery_Time_min


# Create validation split inside training data
set.seed(679)

valid_index <- createDataPartition(
  y_train,
  p = 0.2,
  list = FALSE
)

x_valid <- x_train[valid_index, ]
y_valid <- y_train[valid_index]

x_train_sub <- x_train[-valid_index, ]
y_train_sub <- y_train[-valid_index]

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train_sub, label = y_train_sub)
dvalid <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_valid, label = y_valid)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test, label = y_test)
```

```{r}
xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eta = 0.05,
  max_depth = 4,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

set.seed(679)

xgb_fit <- xgb.train(
  params = xgb_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 1000,
  watchlist = list(
    train = dtrain,
    validation = dvalid
  ),
  early_stopping_rounds = 30,
  verbose = 0
)

xgb_fit$best_iteration

xgb_pred <- predict(xgb_fit, dtest)
```

```{r}
rmse_fun <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
}

mae_fun <- function(actual, predicted) {
  mean(abs(actual - predicted))
}

r2_fun <- function(actual, predicted) {
  1 - sum((actual - predicted)^2) / sum((actual - mean(actual))^2)
}

performance_table <- tibble(
  Model = c(
    "Linear Model",
    "Random Forest",
    "XGBoost"
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    rmse_fun(y_test, lm_pred),
    rmse_fun(y_test, rf_pred),
    rmse_fun(y_test, xgb_pred)
  ),
  MAE = c(
    mae_fun(y_test, lm_pred),
    mae_fun(y_test, rf_pred),
    mae_fun(y_test, xgb_pred)
  ),
  R2 = c(
    r2_fun(y_test, lm_pred),
    r2_fun(y_test, rf_pred),
    r2_fun(y_test, xgb_pred)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE = round(RMSE, 3),
    MAE = round(MAE, 3),
    R2 = round(R2, 3)
  )

performance_table %>%
  kable(caption = "Out-of-Sample Model Performance") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
rf_importance <- importance(rf_fit, type = 1)

rf_importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(rf_importance),
  IncMSE = rf_importance[, 1]
) %>%
  arrange(IncMSE) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = Variable))

ggplot(rf_importance_df, aes(x = IncMSE, y = Variable)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Variable Importance",
    x = "% Increase in MSE",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
pred_df <- tibble(
  Actual = rep(y_test, 3),
  Predicted = c(lm_pred, rf_pred, xgb_pred),
  Model = rep(
    c("Linear Model", "Random Forest", "XGBoost"),
    each = length(y_test)
  )
)

ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Model) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted vs Actual Delivery Time",
    x = "Actual (min)",
    y = "Predicted (min)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
xgb_importance <- xgb.importance(
  feature_names = colnames(x_train),
  model = xgb_fit
)

xgb_importance

# Group dummy variables back into original variable names
xgb_importance_grouped <- xgb_importance %>%
  mutate(
    Original_Variable = case_when(
      str_detect(Feature, "^Distance_km") ~ "Distance",
      str_detect(Feature, "^Preparation_Time_min") ~ "Prep Time",
      str_detect(Feature, "^Courier_Experience_yrs") ~ "Experience",
      str_detect(Feature, "^Weather") ~ "Weather",
      str_detect(Feature, "^Traffic_Level") ~ "Traffic Level",
      str_detect(Feature, "^Time_of_Day") ~ "Time of Day",
      str_detect(Feature, "^Vehicle_Type") ~ "Vehicle Type",
      TRUE ~ Feature
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Original_Variable) %>%
  summarise(Gain = sum(Gain), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Gain) %>%
  mutate(Original_Variable = factor(Original_Variable, levels = Original_Variable))

ggplot(xgb_importance_grouped, aes(x = Gain, y = Original_Variable)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "XGBoost Variable Importance",
    x = "Gain",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
